baseline_models.mechanism: Sight as inward recognition and hearing as understood compliance should pass into intentional repair, but the speakers request that action stage only after certainty has become unavoidable.

activation_trace.role: Inward discernment makes 'we saw' an admission of understanding, not bare optics.
Understanding and compliance make 'we heard' expose the obedient consequence that was missing.
Deliberate action is the missing bridge between recognized truth and صالح.
Repair opposed to corruption specifies the promised work's direction.
Settled knowledge with doubt removed arrives after its practical window.

changed_reading.before: The criminals discover the truth, regret, and ask for another chance.
changed_reading.after: The plea displays a failed knowledge-to-action conversion: certainty has arrived only when it can no longer become repair.

baseline_models.mechanism: The bodily top and the social image of precedence are turned downward at the place of true sovereignty; the repeated رب then converts imposed nearness into direct appeal.

activation_trace.role: Turning the uppermost downward supplies the scene's governing spatial reversal.
Headship and precedence make the lowered head also a collapse of claimed rank.
Nearness and presence locate the reversal before the one addressed.
Ownership and sovereignty identify the authority before whom false precedence collapses.

changed_reading.after: The posture is a total inversion of bodily and social height at the presence of the actual sovereign.

baseline_models.mechanism: A cutting image in جرم meets رب as repair, completion, and growth, then رجوع and صالح: actors now marked as severed ask to re-enter a formative process and produce repair.

activation_trace.role: Cutting and severance give the criminal designation a material loss-of-connection image.
Repair, nurture, and completion make the addressee the governor of formation over time.
The split-root image of feeding and growth sharpens the requested re-entry as renewed development.
Return supplies movement back into the state from which productive action was possible.
Repair against corruption names the desired result of renewed formation.

changed_reading.before: Guilty people ask to replace bad deeds with good deeds.
changed_reading.after: Severed actors ask the nurturing Lord to put them back into formation so their agency can become reparative.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening supplies delivered truth, disturbed doubt, warning, and divine command of both hidden and witnessed domains; the focus certainty is therefore a forced endpoint of resisted evidence, not a first discovery.

activation_trace.role: Delivery and conveyance place evidence within reach before the focus scene.
Doubt as disturbance supplies the earlier unstable state later displaced by يقين.
Stable correspondence with reality makes the prior message evidentially firm.
Warning was meant to awaken caution while response remained possible.
Hiddenness marks what need not yet be visually forced upon the hearer.
Presence with witnessing supplies the manifest pole reached in the focus scene.
Removed doubt is the belated terminus of the earlier evidence path.

structural_cues: 32:2-3 put delivered, doubt-free truth and warning before the confession; 32:6 pairs the hidden and the witnessed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an evidence sequence and the later certainty claim; I infer that manifest encounter compels what warning did not activate, while the alternative is a simpler contrast between earthly message and afterlife sight.

changed_reading.before: The speakers become certain because new evidence has finally appeared.
changed_reading.after: They become certain only when previously delivered evidence has crossed from warnable hiddenness into unavoidable presence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same hearing and sight confessed in the focus were made for humans alongside the inward heart, followed by little gratitude; the organs now function as returned evidence against their bearer.

activation_trace.role: Constitution into a state presents the senses as an endowed human equipment.
Hearing as understanding and compliance identifies the endowment's intended practical use.
Inner discernment links made sight to responsible recognition.
The inwardly kindled heart joins the two outer senses as an interpretive center.
Recognition of a gift names the response whose scarcity follows the endowment.
The requested intentional action is what the endowed senses should already have enabled.

structural_cues: 32:7-9 moves from material formation and breath to made hearing, sights, and hearts, then immediately notes little gratitude.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an endowment followed by scarce gratitude and repeats its senses in the confession; I infer neglected stewardship, though the alternative is that the repetition only recalls universal human equipment.

changed_reading.before: Seeing and hearing are newly acquired afterlife capacities.
changed_reading.after: The confession is the late activation of entrusted capacities that had already been given for grateful, embodied action.

context_deltas.mechanism: Denial of encounter is followed by full collection in death and passive return to the Lord; once that return has occurred, فَٱرْجِعْنَا asks for a second return in the opposite practical direction.

activation_trace.role: Two things meeting face-to-face defines the encounter previously denied.
Covering the truth makes the prior denial active rather than evidentially innocent.
Taking the soul as a whole closes the earthly phase without a loose remainder.
An appointed agent carrying the task through makes the transition administered and complete.
The sovereign Lord is the explicit destination of the first return.
Passive return establishes the movement already accomplished before the plea.
The imperative asks to reverse the completed trajectory back toward actionable life.

structural_cues: 32:10 denies the meeting; 32:11 completes death and return to the Lord immediately before 32:12's request.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two adjacent uses of return with the first directed to the Lord; I infer an opposite deictic direction for the requested return, while the alternative is simply a request for revival without spatial force.

changed_reading.before: They ask to be returned once from judgment to life.
changed_reading.after: Already returned to their Lord, they ask for a return out of that completed return and back into the sphere of work.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next sequence answers a promise of future work with a word already fixed, a vessel filled, reciprocal abandonment, experiential tasting, and judgment because of prior work; proposed intention cannot replace completed agency.

activation_trace.role: A fixed, obligatory due makes the announced word resistant to renegotiation.
Filling to the vessel's measure images a sentence reaching its declared completion.
Mutual wording of leaving and neglecting turns the outcome into a reciprocal relation.
Experiential testing replaces the merely verbal or deferred knowledge of the focus plea.
Past intentional work is named as the operative cause against their future promise.
The same root in the plea offers hypothetical future agency in place of recorded agency.

structural_cues: 32:13 follows the plea with a counterfactual about guidance and a fixed word; 32:14 twice grounds tasting in prior neglect and work.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate answer-like sequencing and repeated causal بما; I infer that completed work outweighs promised work, though the alternative is a general collective explanation rather than a direct reply to each speaker.

changed_reading.before: A sincere promise of better future conduct might reopen the case.
changed_reading.after: The plea tries to substitute hypothetical intention for an already completed history of action and neglect.

context_deltas.mechanism: Those who respond to reminder fall willingly, relinquish bodily rest, and act toward an unseen reward; the criminals first see, then lower their heads and ask to act. The two bodily sequences run in opposite epistemic order.

activation_trace.role: A voluntary sounding fall supplies the active bodily answer to reminder.
Self-lowering and humility give the faithful posture its chosen direction.
The denied self-magnification explains why their lowering is not forced inversion.
The body's springing away from rest extends inward conviction into costly motion.
Hidden reward makes their action precede sight rather than depend on it.
Settling delight in the eyes answers prior unseen action with later sight.
The criminals' humiliated lowering becomes the coerced mirror of chosen prostration.

structural_cues: 32:15-17 runs reminder to prostration to bodily action to hidden reward; 32:12 runs forced sight to lowered posture to requested action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two lowering postures and opposite visibility/action orders; I infer a deliberate bodily contrast, while the alternative is that they share only the broad language of submission.

changed_reading.before: The lowered heads are an isolated sign of remorse.
changed_reading.after: They are a coerced, temporally inverted counterpart to the willing prostration that acted before seeing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context distinguishes desired exit, repeated punitive return, and an earlier corrective return invited by lesser punishment. The focus plea tries to move from the terminal loop back into the corrective kind of return.

activation_trace.role: Desire initiates each attempted exit from the punitive enclosure.
The split-root image of repetition and circling sharpens frustrated desire into a loop.
Passage to the outside names the loop's attempted escape vector.
Return after departure closes each attempted exit.
The non-dominant mapped image of counted recurrence reinforces the explicit كلما cycle.
Nearness marks the lesser punishment as an earlier, proximate intervention.
Return from wrongdoing supplies the corrective return once made available.
The plea requests productive return after correction has given way to terminal recurrence.

structural_cues: 32:20's كلما explicitly repeats attempted exit and forced return; 32:21 gives lesser punishment a prior return-producing purpose.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies corrective and punitive returns around the same plea; I infer distinct return classes and a failed attempt to cross back between them, while the alternative is a looser repetition of return vocabulary.

changed_reading.before: Return is a single binary option: life again or no life again.
changed_reading.after: Return forms a moral topology: timely correction can restore, but terminal return only recycles attempted escape.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same criminal designation follows a remembered sign and deliberate turning of the body's side; in the focus, that evading orientation is answered by the head's forced downward orientation.

activation_trace.role: Bringing something back to mind supplies the rejected opportunity for responsive orientation.
Turning one's side away gives prior refusal a bodily direction.
The repeated criminal label binds the earlier evasion to the focus group.
Punishment after repudiation supplies the directional reversal's consequence.
Turning the uppermost downward answers the earlier turn away with forced reorientation.

structural_cues: 32:22 sequences reminder, turning away, the criminal label, and punishment; 32:12 displays those criminals' later bodily orientation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a shared label and two body-direction verbs; I infer consequential reversal from side-away to head-down, while the alternative is that the conventional posture images are independent.

changed_reading.before: Their shame has no visible history inside the focus verse.
changed_reading.after: The lowered head bodily reverses the earlier choice to turn a side away from reminder.

context_deltas.mechanism: Doubt about meeting is excluded, while patient certainty qualifies leaders who guide before the Lord separates disputes; the criminals possess the same certainty-root only at separation, with headship lowered and no time to guide or work.

activation_trace.role: Doubt and wavering name the state that should be excluded before encounter.
Face-to-face meeting specifies the event about which prior doubt was disallowed.
A leader followed by others activates the headship latent in رُءُوس.
Gentle direction to the right path is certainty's outward social effect.
Holding the self from panic makes certainty a sustained practice rather than a momentary cognition.
Settled knowledge here operates while patience and guidance remain possible.
Judicial separation fixes the endpoint at which disputed claims are decided.
Collapsed headship contrasts with certainty that earlier enabled guiding leadership.
The same settled knowledge becomes inert when claimed only at judicial separation.

structural_cues: 32:23 rejects doubt in meeting, 32:24 couples certainty with patient guidance, and 32:25 places final separation with the Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurring certainty, meeting, leadership, and judgment; I infer an ironic temporal displacement of a useful quality, while the alternative is a category contrast without any lost leadership claim by these speakers.

changed_reading.before: Certainty is the climax and strongest point of their confession.
changed_reading.after: Certainty is a displaced credential: potent when joined to patience and guidance, inert when acquired only after separation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hearing is demanded while walking through the dwellings of destroyed generations, and seeing is demanded as driven water makes cut-bare earth grow food. The focus pair answers a historical and ecological curriculum only after judgment.

activation_trace.role: Falling into destruction makes prior generations an audible historical warning.
People bound in one time turn ruined dwellings into evidence carried across generations.
Walking makes reception of the historical sign bodily and available.
Inhabited dwellings preserve the settled places through which later walkers receive the sign.
Hearing as understanding and compliance identifies the demanded response to historical traces.
Driving water supplies directed causality rather than accidental greening.
Earth cut bare of vegetation gives sight a visible death-to-growth substrate.
Sprouting and cultivation make renewed productivity the visible result.
Inward discernment makes the ecological sight an argument to be grasped.

structural_cues: 32:26 ends with 'will they not hear?' after walked ruins; 32:27 ends with 'will they not see?' after water-driven regeneration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent rhetorical hearing and seeing lessons matching the confession; I infer that 'we heard and saw' belatedly completes this curriculum, while the alternative is only verbal echo across different audiences.

changed_reading.before: The confession reports perception available only at the final scene.
changed_reading.after: It is the overdue answer to evidence already embodied in history underfoot and regeneration before the eyes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The anticipated فتح is an opening by decision that closes the interval for beneficial faith and respite; before it, waiting remains possible, but the focus asks to recover that interval from its far side.

activation_trace.role: Judicial opening and decision name the threshold the questioners demand.
The same deciding opening fixes the day on which response ceases to alter outcome.
Benefit opposed to harm explicitly denies efficacy to belief acquired then.
Waiting and granting time identify the extension no longer given after decision.
Mutual waiting locates the still-open interval on the near side of judgment.
Return would have to recover not just a place but the expired interval of efficacy.

structural_cues: 32:28 asks when the opening comes, 32:29 removes benefit and respite on that day, and 32:30 commands waiting beforehand.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a before/after asymmetry around the opening; I infer that the focus plea seeks lost time as much as lost place, while the alternative is that فتح denotes victory without a direct temporal link to 32:12.

changed_reading.before: Return means relocation from judgment back to earth.
changed_reading.after: Return means the impossible recovery of the pre-decision interval in which certainty, faith, and work could still benefit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a surprising agrarian analogy built from branch-distant cutting, growth, and harvest images; it remains anchored in مجرمون, رب, رجوع, عمل, and صالح and is reinforced by the barren-earth sequence, but downstream prose should present it as a material model rather than substitute agricultural senses into the verse.

activation_trace.role: Cutting and harvesting image the speakers as already severed from a growth phase.
Feeding and growth make Lordly formation analogous to cultivation.
Return becomes a requested new growth interval before final cutting.
Repair against corruption names the hoped-for fruit of renewed cultivation.
The non-dominant mapped image of cutting at maturity makes recompense resemble harvest time.
Vegetation-cut earth supplies the barren condition from which renewal remains imaginable.
Sprouting and cultivation supply the productive alternative the plea seeks.

changed_reading.before: The plea asks for a legal retrial with better behavior.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, it asks for another cultivation season before harvest so severance can become growth and repair.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The illness-relapse and bodily-restoration branches are remote from the surface construction, so this reading is surprising; explicit نكس and رجع plus the later repeated-return loop keep it anchored, but downstream prose should label it a cycle analogy and not diagnose the speakers or override the ordinary return sense.

activation_trace.role: Relapse after apparent recovery makes نكس a warning that reversal can repeat failure.
Restoration of bodily condition supplies the healing outcome they assume return would produce.
Repeated return after attempted departure shows that return itself can imprison rather than restore.
Counted recurrence strengthens the possibility of a cycle rather than a cure.
Corrective return from wrongdoing supplies the healing alternative that had once been available.

changed_reading.before: Any return to life would naturally repair the failed course.
changed_reading.after: The plea may assume restoration where the branch network warns of relapse: another return can reproduce the same cycle rather than heal it.

strongest_changes: The speakers ask for a second, opposite return only after their passive return to the Lord has already been completed.
Their seeing and hearing are belated activations of previously endowed capacities and of historical and ecological evidence already available.
Their lowered heads invert the willing sequence of reminder, prostration, hidden trust, and action found in 32:15-17.
Certainty and return each change function with timing: both can guide and repair before judgment but become inert or punitive after it.
summary.what_was_special: The trace preserves recursive return directions, bodily orientation, the action-before-sight versus sight-before-action reversal, and non-dominant split-root recurrence and cultivation images without collapsing them into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The nurture-and-growth force of the split رب mapping may be diagnostic rather than suitable for unqualified prose.
The voluntary-prostration contrast is structurally strong, but the packet alone does not prove that 32:15 is a direct scene-by-scene mirror of 32:12.
The counted-return, harvest, and relapse models remain live analogies whose branch distance requires explicit containment.
